title: Why Retrieval-Augmented Generation Fails: A Graph Perspective
authors: Kai Guo; Xinnan Dai; Zhibo Zhang; Nuohan Lin; Shenglai Zeng; Jie Ren; Haoyu Han; Jiliang Tang
why_relevant: Analyzes why RAG fails via internal attribution graphs, identifying distraction failure modes (surface-aligned evidence grounding) in mixed-context settings and proposing error detection plus interventions to improve robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Mechanistic interpretability angle is somewhat tangential to mainstream robustness benchmarks.
